highlights_headline: Unreleased changes use operating-system cryptographic randomness to seed hash codes in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp.
highlights_body: Hash codes remain randomized between processes and stable within a process.

bullets.detail: The shared HashCode polyfill now uses RandomNumberGenerator instead of System.Random in both assemblies. Hash codes remain stable within a process; first use now initializes cryptographic randomness.

contributor_summaries.rolfbjarne: Replaced the shared hash seed generator with operating-system cryptographic randomness and added analyzer checks for shipped code
